note: Arms the tree has already measured and refused, for tools/next-arms.py. `arm` is the recipe filename minus `.yaml`; `doc` is the `path:line` whose text records the verdict, and it must be a line that reads as a rejection -- not a plan, a caveat, or a maybe. The planner then prints `skip: <arm> (verdict, doc)` and never places the arm. An entry whose recipe file is gone is reported as `stale-skip` and gates, so a hold cannot outlive the arm it suppressed. Boots already spent are receipted in the cited doc; an entry is deleted when its blocker is measured gone, not when the arm looks interesting again.
